your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Just bought North Carolina Avenue. No complete sets exist on the board yet, so no trades make sense right now. Ending turn.

Landed on Luxury Tax ($100), leaving me with $794. p3 consolidated all 4 railroads by paying big cash to p1 ($350 + Water Works) and p2 ($550), leaving p3 low on cash ($335) and p1/p2 flush. No color sets can be completed yet as every color group still has unowned deeds in the bank. Ending turn.

I only own two properties (Marvin Gardens and North Carolina Ave), which block both Yellow and Green. Selling Marvin Gardens for $360 cash leaves me with just one deed while giving p2 (who has $1419 cash) two Yellows and an easy path to a monopoly once Atlantic Ave is bought. Better to hold my blocking deeds at least until the remaining Yellow/Green deeds are acquired.

Swapping Marvin Gardens for Pacific Avenue right now gives p2 two Yellows with $1419 cash while giving me two Greens with only $794 cash. Since both Atlantic and Pennsylvania are still in the bank, p2 could easily buy or outbid for Atlantic (or even Pennsylvania to block me) and immediately build on Yellow ($150/house vs $200/house on Green). Keeping one Yellow and one Green preserves my leverage in both sets until the third deed in either group is actually purchased.
Passed GO and paid $2 rent on Mediterranean Avenue, bringing my cash to $992. Still no complete color sets possible from current holdings, so ending my turn.
Paid $10 rent on St. Charles Place, leaving me with $1006 cash. Still no complete color sets can be formed from owned properties, so ending my turn.

Rejecting p2's offer of $320 cash for Marvin Gardens. That is even less than the $360 they offered earlier, and I already have $1032 cash with only two deeds. Giving p2 two Yellows for cash makes no strategic sense.
Buying Boardwalk for $400 leaves me with $658 cash, very close to passing GO, and secures half of the Dark Blue two-property group while Park Place is still unowned.
Bought Boardwalk for $400, leaving me with $658 cash and positioned right before GO. No complete color sets can be formed from currently owned deeds, so ending turn.
